english: An urn contains $3$ red balls and $2$ green balls. A ball is drawn at random; if it is red, it is kept aside, and if it is green, it is returned to the urn together with two more green balls. A second ball is then drawn at random from the urn. A player wins Rs. $70$ if the second ball drawn is red and loses Rs. $70$ if it is green. Then the expected gain, in rupees, of the player is ______.
hindi: एक कलश में $3$ लाल तथा $2$ हरी गेंदें हैं। एक गेंद यादृच्छया निकाली जाती है; यदि वह लाल है तो उसे अलग रख दिया जाता है, और यदि वह हरी है तो उसे दो और हरी गेंदों के साथ कलश में वापस डाल दिया जाता है। फिर कलश से दूसरी गेंद यादृच्छया निकाली जाती है। यदि दूसरी निकाली गई गेंद लाल है तो खिलाड़ी $70$ रुपये जीतता है तथा यदि हरी है तो $70$ रुपये हारता है। तब खिलाड़ी का प्रत्याशित लाभ (रुपयों में) ______ है।
solution: Given first red: urn has $2R,2G$, $P(R_{2}\mid R_{1})=\dfrac{2}{4}$; given first green: $3R,4G$, $P(R_{2}\mid G_{1})=\dfrac{3}{7}$
solution_full: Let $R_{1}$, $G_{1}$ be the colour of the first ball and $R_{2}$ the event that the second ball is red. $P(R_{1})=\dfrac{3}{5}$, $P(G_{1})=\dfrac{2}{5}$.

Reduced urns: given $R_{1}$, the red ball is kept aside, leaving $2$ red and $2$ green, so $P(R_{2}\mid R_{1})=\dfrac{1}{2}$. Given $G_{1}$, the urn becomes $3$ red and $4$ green, so $P(R_{2}\mid G_{1})=\dfrac{3}{7}$.
Law of total probability: $P(R_{2})=\dfrac{3}{10}+\dfrac{6}{35}=\dfrac{21+12}{70}=\dfrac{33}{70}$, so $P(\text{second green})=\dfrac{37}{70}$.
originality_note: New: an urn whose update rule differs by colour (red removed, green returned with two more), so the second draw is computed from two different reduced urns and turned into the value of a bet (way 5: conditional probability, multiplication theorem and total probability in one game). Closest known: JEE Main 'urn with 5 red and 2 green, a ball of the other colour is added' problems. Different because: the two branches change the urn in opposite directions and the answer is the expected value of a symmetric bet.
blueprint_concepts: Conditional probability and the reduced sample space

concept_use.Conditional probability and the reduced: P(R2 | R1) = 1/2 and P(R2 | G1) = 3/7 are read from the reduced urns.
concept_use.Multiplication theorem: P(R1 n R2) and P(G1 n R2) are products P(first) P(second | first).
concept_use.Law of total probability: P(R2) = 33/70 is the sum over the two first-draw outcomes (law of total probability).
